source: Expected values come from python: the exact decimal of the f32 scale rounded to 6 significant digits with the decimal module (half-even on the exact value, what Rust's {:.5e} does for exact ties), float() of that decimal (correct rounding to f64), then struct float32 (round-half-even), the Rust parse-as-f64-then-cast-to-f32 chain. Exact seventh-digit ties are found by search over m*2^e. A decimal within half a double ulp of a binary32 midpoint (the double-rounding branch) cannot be constructed from a real scale, so that branch is argued, not exercised.

cases.id: six-digit decimals and the digit boundary
exact ties at the seventh digit round to even
neighbours of ties round to their side
powers of two across the whole range
tiny and huge decimals that were out of the old range
